args.body: Dear Margaret, we received an email today asking us to change your bank details for rent payments. It came from a slightly different address to yours and with a different reply-to, so we have not made any change. For your protection we need to verify it by phone on the number we hold for you. Please let us know a good time to call. If you did not send it, please do not act on it and consider checking your email security. Your Monday payment is on hold until we have spoken. Our team will contact you again by Monday morning. Kind regards, Mare & Co
